accepted_limitations.gz_capture_trace_race: intermittent per-fixture-session gz-transport delivery failure of the capture_trace topic, fail-closed at the pre-arm readiness gate, worked around by the fresh-fixture-pod retry ladder; root mechanism open (probe pair retained)
accepted_limitations.standing_waivers: Phase 2 recognition waiver; capture-time TF witness sidecar; UDP companion path; sensors-system override; grace/heartbeat-acceleration authority mechanics; render warmup; liveness retry ladder (infrastructure deaths only)
accepted_limitations.lethal_254_framing: the passing on-arm is the implementation plan's exclusion experiment demonstrating the semantic objective's ceiling; the production candidate remains the qualified soft cost 200 (a model-only restriction is not a production safety boundary)
